ticket: ADT-FOV: add DA3-Small to the baseline line-up
smoke_test: da3s_smoke -- da3_small loads and scores 3 frames without pulling weights on first use failing. OK.
context_grid_note: The harness refused --context-frames > 1 with dav2_large in --models ('dav2_large is monocular and cannot use a context'). Dropped dav2_large from the 4 context arms (kept only in the N=1 baseline, da3s_ctx_n1) -- same convention #22 already documents for slambench's context sweep.

six_seq_pen.read: da3_small's pen (proportional rim penalty) is LOWER than da3_large's in every column, but its absolute AbsRel is worse everywhere -- roughly 2x da3_large's, at every incidence-angle bin, both streams and both views. DA3-Small is simply a worse model overall; capacity does not remove the periphery penalty, it just makes the model's already-larger floor error dilute the relative rim/center ratio. Not tuning further, per the ticket's own instruction.

context_behaviour_rect_real_AbsRel_0to10.read: Same direction as da3_large: both models improve monotonically with more context frames, and strided (stride 10) beats consecutive (stride 1) at every frame count for both models. da3_large's N1->10f_s10 move (0.077->0.048) reproduces the historical 0.0774->0.0478 figure almost exactly. da3_small shows the identical qualitative pattern (0.155->0.121) but a smaller relative gain (~22% vs da3_large's ~38%).

context_behaviour_pen_rect.read: da3_small's rect pen drops BELOW 1.0 with any context (0.94-0.99) -- meaning with multi-frame context da3_small is scored no worse (even marginally better) at the rim than at the centre in the rectified view. da3_large's pen stays >1.2 throughout. This is the one qualitative difference: context flattens (and for da3_small, inverts) the pen curve more than it does for da3_large.

context_behaviour_pen_fisheye.read: On the raw fisheye view, da3_large's pen actually WORSENS with more context (1.45->2.02) -- more frames sharpen the centre more than the rim. da3_small's fisheye pen stays roughly flat (1.17-1.24) regardless of context. So on fisheye specifically the two models diverge: da3_large's periphery penalty grows with context, da3_small's does not move.
